Review_Text: Outstanding service and honest pricing. They diagnosed my car issue accurately, fixed it within hours, and charged less than estimated. Found my forever mechanic! Would definitely recommend checking it out!
Mixed impression. The appetizers were delightful, but the main courses felt hurried and lacked seasoning. Helpful staff though. Packaging was decent.
Mediocre stay. Cleanliness was questionable and the bed was uncomfortable. Would look for alternative options next time in town. #verifiedpurchase
Review update after 3 months: Phenomenal dining experience! Every course was a culinary masterpiece, the service was impeccable, and the ambience was magical. Best restaurant in the city!
Absolute 5-star experience! Our server was knowledgeable, friendly, and timed each dish to perfection. The flavors were vibrant and authentic. Packaging was decent.
Very enjoyable visit. Loved the artisan coffee and freshly baked pastries. A wonderful quiet corner to read or get work done.
Bought this recently. Decent spot, nothing extraordinary. The food was okay, service was acceptable, and the prices were fair for the neighborhood.

Summary: Fair experience. Room was adequately clean and bed was fine, but breakfast options were sparse and wifi was somewhat spotty.
Wonderful experience overall. The staff was courteous and accommodating. The rooms were spotless and nicely appointed. Will visit again. Would definitely recommend checking it out!
Underwhelming experience. The place looks great on social media, but reality falls short. Portions are small and flavors are muted. Packaging was decent.
Terrible hygiene and filthy tables. Saw flies around the counter and the bathroom had no soap or paper towels. Health department needs to inspect this. Would definitely recommend checking it out!
Bought this recently. Rude management and hostile attitude towards customers. They charged us hidden fees on our bill that were never disclosed upfront.
Never coming back here! The staff was dismissive, the room smelled of damp mold, and the AC was broken during a heatwave. Disastrous stay. Hope this review helps someone make up their mind.
Great atmosphere and delicious food! The pasta was freshly handmade and the wine selection was impressive. Service was attentive and friendly. Packaging was decent.

Exceptional service from check-in to departure. The staff treated us like royalty, the suite was gorgeous with breathtaking views, and the spa was heavenly. Would definitely recommend checking it out!
Summary: Extremely unprofessional. Had an appointment booked two weeks in advance, waited 45 minutes past the scheduled time, and was treated rudely by reception.
Summary: Great meal with friends. Flavorful dishes, generous portions, and vibrant vibe. Only knock was the slightly elevated noise level.
Bought this recently. High quality service and clean facilities. Doctor and nurses were thorough, gentle, and answered all my questions patiently.
Not worth the hype or the high prices. Decent location, but the amenities are outdated and the rooms need urgent renovation. #verifiedpurchase
Dirty facilities, loud noise all night, and indifferent staff who clearly did not care about our comfort. Avoid this place. Hope this review helps someone make up their mind.
Summary: Average food with very slow service. We waited almost an hour for appetizers. The staff tried hard, but they were clearly understaffed.
Average experience overall. Convenient location and clean space, but parking was a nightmare and wait times were a bit long. Thanks to the team for the prompt service!
Beautiful spot for an evening stroll. Well-maintained pathways, lovely landscaping, and safe environment for families. Parking fills up quickly though. #verifiedpurchase
